Quelques repères pour choisir le bon câb: A few tips to choose the right cable and port.
Le contrôleur, le port, les hubs, le câb: The controller, port, hubs, cable and device all affect negotiation. Replacing any one of them may change the link speed.
SuperSpeedPlus est une catégorie : 10 Gb: SuperSpeedPlus means 10 Gbit/s or faster. This version does not distinguish 10 and 20 Gbit/s modes or inspect USB4 / Thunderbolt links.
1. Branchez un périphérique USB 3 connu: 1. Connect a known USB 3 device directly to a known USB 3 port.
2. Notez la vitesse négociée et le numér: 2. Note the negotiated speed and port number.
3. Remplacez uniquement le câble, puis a: 3. Change only the cable, then wait for the next scan.
4. Si la liaison redescend à 480 Mb/s, v: 4. If the link drops to 480 Mbit/s, check the cable and connectors.
Un câble de charge sans données ne crée: A charge-only cable does not create a detectable device. A USB-C connector does not guarantee a speed. This version does not read USB Power Delivery or the cable's e-marker.
Application native en Rust, inspirée de: A native Rust application inspired by WhatCable and USB Device Tree Viewer.
Analyse locale en lecture seule, sans te: Local, read-only scanning, without file transfer tests or driver changes. JSON exports may include serial numbers and system identifiers.
Le débit utile dépend du périphérique et: Actual throughput depends on the device and protocol.
Vitesse maximale du câble seul: Maximum speed of the cable alone
La version du descripteur USB décrit le: The USB descriptor version describes the device. It is not a speed measurement or a cable certification.
Aucune interface détaillée exposée par l: The system exposes no detailed interfaces for this driver.
Un hub sur la branche USB 2.0: A hub on the USB 2.0 branch
Un hub USB 3 peut exposer une branche US: A USB 3 hub may expose separate USB 2.0 and SuperSpeed branches. This 480 Mbit/s entry alone does not show that the cable limits the hub. Check the other branches too.
Windows signale un périphérique compatib: Windows reports a SuperSpeed-capable device, but the link uses USB 2.0. Try a direct USB 3 port, then another cable. The cable, port or a hub may limit the connection.
Le système ne fournit pas la vitesse de: The system does not provide the link speed. Try another port and refresh the scan.
Cette vitesse est courante pour un clavi: This speed is common for keyboards, mice and audio devices. It cannot determine the cable's capability.
La connexion utilise High Speed. Si votr: The connection uses High Speed. If the device supports USB 3, compare using a known USB 3 cable and port without an intermediate hub.
La liaison fonctionne à 5 Gb/s. Le traje: The link runs at 5 Gbit/s, so the path supports SuperSpeed. The maximum speed of the cable alone remains unknown.
Le système signale une liaison à 10 Gb/s: The system reports 10 Gbit/s or faster. This does not distinguish 10 and 20 Gbit/s modes or measure file transfer speed.
Le service de détection USB s’est arrêté: The USB scanning service stopped. You can scan again.
Des contrôleurs USB sont visibles, mais: USB controllers are visible, but no devices can be read. If devices are connected, check hub access permissions; a sandbox may block access.
